frame.note: A schematic frame, not a projection. No household location is published: a base is drawn at the head of its valley or ridge, never at its door.

places.name: H2O House
places.label: River base
places.description: An ancestral property on the Saal river below Chamba: five rustic huts built over the water and two sitting rooms.
places.arrival: The host collects guests from the Chamba bus stand.
places.locationNote: The village and the road time from Chamba are not confirmed. We show it as the river base near Chamba until they are.

places.name: Mystic Village
places.label: Ridge base
places.description: A 200-year-old Gaddi village at Bhaloli on the Khajjiar ridge: five mud-and-slate houses and two handcrafted cottages, run as a community homestay.
places.arrival: Road from Khajjiar to Rota, then about a 2 km walk in through deodar.

places.name: Chamba town
places.label: Town
places.description: The old hill capital on the Ravi: the Chaugan, the Laxmi Narayan temples and the rumal, chappal and metal workshops.

places.name: Khajjiar
places.label: Day-trip stop
places.description: The meadow every day trip stops at. The road to the ridge base turns off here.

places.name: Dalhousie
places.label: Hotels
places.description: Where most guests already have a bed when they first hear of us.

places.name: Chamba bus stand
places.label: Arrival
places.description: Where the river base collects guests.

places.name: Pathankot
places.label: Railhead
places.description: The railhead. Most guests arrive on the overnight train from Delhi.

legs.note: Road to Rota, then about a 2 km walk in.
